about: The standing contract: every suite here must report zero FAIL against staging, exactly as served, before anything is promoted. A suite is any script that takes the base URL as its first argument, prints PASS/FAIL lines and exits non-zero on failure. Add a suite by adding a row. 'prod_safe' suites only read pages, so they may also run against production. 'alone' suites measure pixels or speed and run after the others, one at a time. 'out_flag' names the option that receives a folder for files a suite writes (for example screenshots).

suites.name: structure
suites.covers: every page reachable from / answers 200 and has a title, one h1, a language and image alt text

suites.name: links
suites.covers: every internal link, stylesheet, script and image resolves
